title.zh: 商品与服务税（海关法 1960 的适用）（关于审讯、程序、罪行与罚则的规定）命令 1994
title.en: Goods and Services Tax (Application of Customs Act 1960) (Provisions on Trials, Proceedings, Offences and Penalties) Order 1994

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Goods and Services Tax (Application of Customs Act 1960) (Provisions on Trials, Proceedings, Offences and Penalties) Order 1994.

2. Parts 14 and 15 (with the exception of sections 133, 135 and 136) of the Customs Act 1960 apply to trials, proceedings, offences and penalties in relation to offences under the Act as they apply in relation to offences and penalties under the Customs Act 1960 as defined in that Act.
